title: On the stable Hopf invariant
summary: We provide a simplified approach to the the stable Hopf invariant. We provide short elementary proofs of the Cartan Formula, the Composition Formula, and the Transfer formula. In addition, when $π$ is a discrete group, we show how to extend these results to the stable category of $π$-spaces. We also consider the extent to which the stable Hopf invariant is unique.
